principle: Maintain facts once, keep each explanation with its owner, and project the facts into bounded Codex and Claude views and generated references.

areas.title: Obsidian configuration
areas.purpose: Personal graph and vault display configuration; graph colors are validated while personal view state is preserved.

areas.title: Documentation and graph
areas.purpose: Human architecture and build guidance, generated references, and generated Obsidian entries; never runtime selection authority.

areas.title: Skills Orchestrator control plane
areas.purpose: Shared runtime, registry, host adapters, deterministic tools, governance contracts, and integration tests.

areas.title: Compatibility command
areas.purpose: Temporary one-release wrapper for scripts/skills_ai; all implementation lives in orchestrator/tools.

areas.title: Public skill packages
areas.purpose: Repository-owned packages, separately owned Git submodules, and declared external pointers grouped under one visible package root.

areas.title: Non-runtime workbench
areas.purpose: External change requests, unimplemented plans, and optional reviewed examples; never skill or routing authority.

artifact_overrides..gitignore: Declares repository-local paths Git should not track.
artifact_overrides..gitmodules: Declares each separately owned skill submodule: path, remote URL and tracked branch.
artifact_overrides.AGENTS.md: Generated standalone Codex repository entry containing shared rules plus the Codex lifecycle overlay.
artifact_overrides.CLAUDE.md: Generated standalone Claude repository entry containing shared rules plus the Claude hook overlay.
artifact_overrides.README.md: Repository front door: what Skills AI is, a map by depth to every folder's entry, and how to clone or share it; it is never runtime routing authority.
artifact_overrides.orchestrator/adapters/codex/ENTRY.md: Canonical Codex-only invocation and session-ownership overlay used to generate AGENTS.md.
artifact_overrides.orchestrator/adapters/claude/ENTRY.md: Canonical Claude-only hook, child-lifecycle, and acceptance overlay used to generate CLAUDE.md.
Canonical agent rules shared by generated Codex and Claude repository entries.
artifact_overrides.orchestrator/runtime/manifest.json: Generated capability metadata and activation gates consumed by shared discovery/loading.
artifact_overrides.orchestrator/tools/skills_ai: Executable terminal entry for shared inspection, containment, reviewed deployment and host refresh.
artifact_overrides.orchestrator/tools/skills_ai.py: Thin Python entry for the modular maintenance command interface.
artifact_overrides.orchestrator/governance/TERMINAL_MAINTEN: On-demand agent protocol for terminal maintenance commands, results, approval, host adapters and recovery.
artifact_overrides.orchestrator/governance/GIT_GOVERNANCE.m: On-demand agent protocol for repository ownership, clone modes, the child-first commit order, branches, versions, releases, rollback, dirty state and cleanup.
artifact_overrides.skills_ai.code-workspace: VS Code multi-root workspace listing the parent and each package so every package's own editor settings apply and Source Control shows each repository separately.
artifact_overrides.docs/generated/FILE_INDEX.md: Generated exhaustive reference for repository files, ownership, roles, and purposes.
artifact_overrides.docs/generated/SKILL_CATALOG.md: Generated package-first reference for public skills, internal capabilities, triggers, states, and package contents.

orchestrator.purpose: Always-active control plane for routing, lifecycle management, documentation coordination, and bounded project context; never counted as a skill.
